rationale: Correct Harquahala as one active single-asset generation company owned 50/50 by Capital Power and BlackRock's GEPIF III vehicle from the February 16, 2024 closing. The existing ledger direction was reversed: BlackRock entered rather than exited. Capital Power and BlackRock acquired 100% from CSG Investments, which is retained as the former owner. Direct transaction, regulatory and audited-report evidence supports the legal identity, 1,092 MW operating asset, GEPIF III vehicle, ownership percentages and current status. The 2004 date is commercial operation, not company formation, and no separate GIP ownership period is supported.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Harquahala Generation Company is the manager-level record for New Harquahala Generating Company, LLC, owner of a 1,092 MW combined-cycle natural-gas generation facility in Maricopa County, Arizona. The plant supplies wholesale energy, capacity and grid-reliability services and is 100% tolled through 2031 with an undisclosed investment-grade utility. Capital Power operates, maintains and manages the facility. Capital Power and BlackRock announced a 50/50 acquisition from CSG Investments in November 2023 and closed the purchase on February 16, 2024. BlackRock invested through its Global Energy & Power Infrastructure Fund III Trident structure. Capital Power's 2025 annual report and Q2 2026 report continued to show the 50% joint-venture interest and operating facility. The plant began commercial operation in 2004; that date is not treated as the legal company's founding year. No later sale, ownership transfer or signed pending exit was identified through August 23, 2026.
